messages:
ajay: heads up — console sluggish after telemetry rollout. Charts take ~400ms to paint on load, LCP spikes. anyone seeing this? :eyes:

maria: saw it. repro on prod canary. waterfall shows huge `telemetry` payload blocking render. payload ~720KB

drew: looks like new `telemetry.v2` endpoint returns full snapshots now instead of diffs. frontend calls on route change -> blocks chart render

maria: snippet from network:
```
POST /api/internal/telemetry/v2
payload-size: 738212
body: {events: [... huge array ...]}
```

lisa: backend started enforcing per-route quotas yesterday. when quota hits we 429 and client retries with exponential backoff, doubling requests. saw 429s at 12:02:13

ops-bot: deploy: telemetry/v2 rolled to canary (hash: abc123) by @signe at 2026-03-20T12:00:00Z

ajay: why did telemetry switch to full snapshots? that seems like a perf regression for everyone

drew: looks like routing policy changed to route `console` traffic to `ingest-v2` which only supports snapshot mode. config PR: `platform/routing#1123`

sam: quick mitigation: 1) revert to diff mode on canary 2) sample telemetry on initial load 3) lazy fetch non-blocking events after charts render

maria: +1. also we should debounce route-change telemetry and cap payload to 64KB

lisa: can we also tune quota logic to return `202 Accepted` + queued instead of 429 to avoid retries? would prevent thundering retries

ajay: agree. i'll open rollback PR and feature-flag the v2 behavior. canary stays disabled for console until we validate

drew: created issue by hand: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/3288 — includes heap of traces and network logs

sam: will prototype client patch: sampleRate=0.1, deferTelemetryAfterRender=true. pushing branch `eng/telemetry-lite`

maria: thanks. once patch lands, can we do a perf canary (10% users) + quick prometheus dashboard for LCP and network payload sizes?

ajay: yep. assigning @sam and @drew to rollout + observability. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0312 — Console telemetry regression. Severity: P2

lisa: FYI we also found one client path where query param `full=true` is being set by mistake. fix inbound in `console-router` PR

drew: patch merged to revert routing change. keep an eye on errors for 5m

maria: can confirm charts are back to baseline on canary after the revert. LCP down ~220ms

ajay: great ship it to prod after 30m stable and perf gating
